purpose: Reusable Music Drama shot-pattern grammar for still-image scenario composition. Patterns define framing intent only — not generated scenario text.

patterns.label: Establishing Daily Life
patterns.shot_role: open the viewer into a readable ordinary moment
patterns.framing_intent: wide-to-medium view of one primary location with protagonist clearly anchored
patterns.music_drama_function: lyric-aligned opening still that establishes emotional baseline

patterns.label: Companion Bond Moment
patterns.shot_role: show emotional readability through human-animal proximity
patterns.framing_intent: medium shot with protagonist and companion animal sharing frame space
scenario_field_focus: visible shared action between protagonist and companion
patterns.music_drama_function: quiet relationship beat supporting lyric warmth without dialogue exposition
patterns.rkb_note: RKB-001 validated Gamja companion stability in this pattern

patterns.label: Domestic Warmth
patterns.shot_role: express family comfort inside home or bakery interior
patterns.framing_intent: interior medium shot with warm domestic props and limited cast
patterns.music_drama_function: home-space emotional anchor for lyric passages about peace and belonging
patterns.risk_mitigation: avoid complex bedding geometry per RKB-001 object deformation finding

patterns.label: Bakery Morning
patterns.shot_role: anchor morning routine through bakery warmth and food preparation context
patterns.framing_intent: medium shot centered on bakery counter, oven glow, or window display
character_field_focus: optional queue extras as background only
patterns.music_drama_function: daily-life rhythm beat aligned with morning lyric sections

patterns.label: Harbor Edge Watch
patterns.shot_role: connect protagonist to sea, labor, and horizon without plot exposition
patterns.framing_intent: medium-wide shot with harbor elements and protagonist at rail, bench, or pier edge
character_field_focus: distant dock workers only if clearly visible
patterns.music_drama_function: horizon-gazing lyric still suggesting quiet future possibility

patterns.label: Street Passage
patterns.shot_role: move protagonist through village lanes with readable environment
patterns.framing_intent: tracking still of one lane or staircase with protagonist mid-passage
patterns.music_drama_function: transitional lyric still between domestic and harbor spaces

patterns.label: Quiet Solitude
patterns.shot_role: hold one emotionally readable solitary moment
patterns.framing_intent: medium close still with minimal background activity
patterns.music_drama_function: internal lyric pause rendered through environment and posture, not monologue

patterns.label: Rooftop Gaze
patterns.shot_role: elevated still looking over village roofline or wall boundary
patterns.framing_intent: medium-wide elevated view with protagonist at roof edge or high window
patterns.music_drama_function: lyric bridge about unchanged world and quiet curiosity
